test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 21th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A specific amount of money quadruples itself in 8 years under simple interest. How many years will it take to become 12 times the initial amount at the same rate??
solution:
**Given:**

Money becomes 4 times in 8 years (Simple Interest)

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest Amount = P × (1 + r × t)

**Calculations:**

Quadruples ⇒ Final amount = 4P

⇒ Increase = 4P − P = 3P in 8 years

⇒ Increase per year = 3P ÷ 8

To become 12 times ⇒ Final amount = 12P

⇒ Required increase = 12P − P = 11P

⇒ Time required = (11P ÷ (3P ÷ 8))

⇒ Time required = 11 × 8 ÷ 3

⇒ Time required = 88 ÷ 3

⇒ Time required = 29 ¹⁄₃ years

**∴ The required time is 29 ¹⁄₃ years.**
